The same came into being during the Swadeshi movement {{Cite web |title=South Ind.Bank Summary: Latest Updates and Details |url=https://www.indiainfoline.com/company/south-indian-bank-ltd/summary |access-date=2026-07-30 |website=India Infoline |language=en}}. It began as a private limited company and was later converted into a public limited company in 1939. The bank provides retail and corporate banking services, para banking activities, third party distribution along with Treasury and Foreign Exchange Business {{Cite web |title=South Ind.Bank Summary: Latest Updates and Details |url=https://www.indiainfoline.com/company/south-indian-bank-ltd/summary |access-date=2026-07-30 |website=India Infoline |language=en}}. As of 31 December 2024, the bank had a network of 955 banking outlets (954 branches and 1 service branch) and 1290 ATMs/CRMs (1159 ATMs and 131 CRMs) spanning 26 states and 4 union territories).[https://www.southindianbank.bank.in southindianbank.bank.in]{{cite web |title=About us |url=https://www.southindianbank.bank.in/about-us/about-sib |access-date=2025-11-06 |website=The South Indian Bank Ltd |publisher=South Indian Bank Ltd}} ==History of SIB== [[File:Southindianbank logo.gif|thumb|left|190px|'''Old logo''']] South Indian Bank was registered in 1929 under the [[Companies Act]].{{cite web |title=SOUTH INDIAN BANK LIMITED |url=https://www.zaubacorp.com/company/SOUTH-INDIAN-BANK-LIMITED/U65191KL1928PLC001011 |website=Zauba Corp}} It commenced business on 29 January 1929 at Round South, [[Thrissur]]. The first branch to open outside Kerala was in [[Coimbatore]], in 1941. It was included in the second schedule of the [[Reserve Bank of India]] and became a scheduled bank on 7 August 1946. SIB was the first scheduled bank in the private sector in [[Kerala]] to get the license under Section 22 of the [[Banking Regulation Act, 1949]] from the RBI on 17 June 1957. During 1963, the bank took over the assets and liabilities of Krishnavilasam Banking Company Ltd. and Ambat Bank Pvt Ltd., Chittur, Kerala {{Cite web |title=South Ind.Bank Summary: Latest Updates and Details |url=https://www.indiainfoline.com/company/south-indian-bank-ltd/summary |access-date=2026-07-30 |website=India Infoline |language=en}}. The year 1964 is a major period for the bank- the bank had acquired 10 banks including Public Bank Ltd, Suburban Bank Pvt. Ltd., Vijalakshmi Bank Pvt Ltd, Chalakudy Bank Ltd, Mukkattukara Catholic Bank Ltd, Assyrian Charities Banking Company Ltd, The Catholic Syrian Christian Bank Ltd, Malabar Bank Ltd, Bharata Union Bank Ltd and Kozhuvanal Bank Ltd. In 1990, SIB made an entry into merchant banking activities by supporting 99 issues. A currency chest activity was executed in April 1992 {{Cite web |title=South Ind.Bank Summary: Latest Updates and Details |url=https://www.indiainfoline.com/company/south-indian-bank-ltd/summary |access-date=2026-07-30 |website=India Infoline |language=en}}. Also in 1992, the bank opened their first NRI branch. In 1993, the bank started an Industrial Finance Branch in March, and opened an overseas branch to cater to import-export business in June {{Cite web |title=South Ind.Bank Summary: Latest Updates and Details |url=https://www.indiainfoline.com/company/south-indian-bank-ltd/summary |access-date=2026-07-30 |website=India Infoline |language=en}}. Their Initial Public Offering was made and taken to the public in the year 1998. And in 2001, Sibertech (Technology Promotion Drive of South Indian Bank) was conceptualised as a comprehensive and centralised banking solution {{Cite web |title=South Ind.Bank Summary: Latest Updates and Details |url=https://www.indiainfoline.com/company/south-indian-bank-ltd/summary |access-date=2026-07-30 |website=India Infoline |language=en}}. That year, SIB also entered into an alliance with three exchange houses in Gulf. In the year 2002, a tie-up was also made between the bank and an insurance payer for distributing the products of the latter {{Cite web |title=South Ind.Bank Summary: Latest Updates and Details |url=https://www.indiainfoline.com/company/south-indian-bank-ltd/summary |access-date=2026-07-30 |website=India Infoline |language=en}}. The internet banking facility, namely Sibernet was introduced to the customers in 2003. They also made an agreement between [[Mastercard|MasterCard]] International to launch Maestro, the global ATM/Debit Card {{Cite web |title=South Ind.Bank Summary: Latest Updates and Details |url=https://www.indiainfoline.com/company/south-indian-bank-ltd/summary |access-date=2026-07-30 |website=India Infoline |language=en}}. During 2004, the bank had celebrated 75 years. The follow on public offering was made in 2005 https://www.indiainfoline.com/company/south-indian-bank-ltd/summary . In FY06, SIB opened 21 new branches and 11 extension counters. The bank had tied up with [[Mastercard]] Inc. for Global debit and ATM card operations to spread their ATM reach {{Cite web |title=South Ind.Bank Summary: Latest Updates and Details |url=https://www.indiainfoline.com/company/south-indian-bank-ltd/summary |access-date=2026-07-31 |website=India Infoline |language=en}}. During this year, the bank launched net banking as well as SMS based mobile banking. This helped their customers banking activities in a more quicker and cheaper manner {{Cite web |title=South Ind.Bank Summary: Latest Updates and Details |url=https://www.indiainfoline.com/company/south-indian-bank-ltd/summary |access-date=2026-07-31 |website=India Infoline |language=en}}. In FY14, the bank had introduced direct and indirect tax payment facility its retail and corporate customers {{Cite web |title=South Ind.Bank Summary: Latest Updates and Details |url=https://www.indiainfoline.com/company/south-indian-bank-ltd/summary |access-date=2026-07-31 |website=India Infoline |language=en}}. The same year, a kiosk banking model was launched by the bank. It is a kind of model that delivers banking services at customer end {{Cite web |title=South Ind.Bank Summary: Latest Updates and Details |url=https://www.indiainfoline.com/company/south-indian-bank-ltd/summary |access-date=2026-07-31 |website=India Infoline |language=en}}. In FY18, the bank had a tie up with Kotak Mahindra Life Insurance Ltd. and [[SBI Life Insurance Company|SBI Life Insurance]] Co. Ltd. in addition to its existing partner of [[Life Insurance Corporation]] of India. The bank also had a tie up with the New India Assurance Co. Ltd. as their second partner for general insurance in addition to Bajaj Allianz General Insurance Co. Ltd {{Cite web |title=South Ind.Bank Summary: Latest Updates and Details |url=https://www.indiainfoline.com/company/south-indian-bank-ltd/summary |access-date=2026-08-01 |website=India Infoline |language=en}}. The bank has won the 'UiPath Automation Excellence Awards 2021' for Best Automation under crisis for business continuity.{{Cite web |title=https://www.southindianbank.bank.in/news-and-events |url=https://www.southindianbank.bank.in/news-and-events |access-date=2026-05-26 |website=www.southindianbank.bank.in |language=en}} The total deposits of the bank, as of March 2026 was Rs. 1,23,346.32 crore as against the amount of Rs. 1,07,525.60 a year ago. The bank registered a growth of 14.71% this year {{Cite web |title=South Ind.Bank Summary: Latest Updates and Details |url=https://www.indiainfoline.com/company/south-indian-bank-ltd/summary |access-date=2026-08-01 |website=India Infoline |language=en}}. == Operations == === Employees === The bank is committed to gender inclusive hiring, with men and women employees taking up equal proportions of the workforce. Around 30% of the workers are also disabled https://www.southindianbank.bank.in/userfiles/file/sib_brsr_2026.pdf {{Bare URL PDF|date=August 2026}}. To make the space more inclusive and accessible, several measures have been taken up by the bank as well. A significant portion of the office is in the ground floor, the entryways are equipped with ramps, and other accessibility features have been made available to the disabled people in the office. Moreover, the HR policy of the bank mandates hiring on the basis of equal opportunity https://www.southindianbank.bank.in/userfiles/file/sib_brsr_2026.pdf {{Bare URL PDF|date=August 2026}}. ==Board of directors== * Jose Joseph Kattoor - Chairman * P R Seshadri - Managing Director and CEO * M George Korah - Director * Pradeep M. Godbole - Director *[[Paul Antony (civil servant)|Paul Antony]] IAS (Retd.) - Director *R A Sankaranarayanan - Director *Benny P Thomas - Director *Lakshmi Ramakrishna Srinivas - Director * Thomson Thomas - Director *Dolphy Jose - Executive Director == Other Initiatives == === Kiosk Banking === In the Financial Year of 2014, a new banking channel was introduced by the bank- Kiosk Banking Model. This new initiative ensures that banking services are delivered at customer end {{Cite web |title=South Ind.Bank Summary: Latest Updates and Details |url=https://www.indiainfoline.com/company/south-indian-bank-ltd/summary |access-date=2026-08-01 |website=India Infoline |language=en}}. This initiative offers basic services like customer enrolment, deposits, withdrawal, fund transfers, balance enquiry, FD, RD remittance, etc to its potential customers. The customers can now open a new basic savings account in the kiosk centre by providing KYC documents and biometrics {{Cite web |title=South Ind.Bank Summary: Latest Updates and Details |url=https://www.indiainfoline.com/company/south-indian-bank-ltd/summary |access-date=2026-08-01 |website=India Infoline |language=en}}. Banking Transactions can be conducted without a cheque leaf or an ATM card. The same was made available across Kerala through Akshaya Centres {{Cite web |title=South Ind.Bank Summary: Latest Updates and Details |url=https://www.indiainfoline.com/company/south-indian-bank-ltd/summary |access-date=2026-08-01 |website=India Infoline |language=en}}. === CSR Activities === The core area of CSR activities of SIB is Eradicating Hunger, Poverty and Malnutrition, Promoting education and provision of vocational training, promoting gender equality, Contribution to national funds (such as [[PM CARES Fund|PM Cares]] or any other funds set up for helping the minorities), and contribution to creating technology incubators in academic institutions. Other areas of work includes Ensuring Environmental Stability, Protection of national heritage, and Measures for the benefits of armed force, rural development projects and slum area development https://www.southindianbank.bank.in/userfiles/file/csr_policy.pdf {{Bare URL PDF|date=August 2026}}. == Awards == * In 2006, the bank won a special award for excellence in Banking Technology from [[Institute for Development and Research in Banking Technology|IDRBT]] https://www.indiainfoline.com/company/south-indian-bank-ltd/summary . * Recently, in 2026, the bank sweeped multiple awards at the IBA Banking Technology Awards, 2024-25 {{Cite web |date=2026-01-14 |title=South Indian Bank Wins Big at IBA Awards |url=https://www.passionateinmarketing.com/south-indian-bank-sweeps-iba-banking-awards-2024-25/ |access-date=2026-07-31 |website=Passionate In Marketing |language=en-US}}. The awards won by them includes the 'Best Tech Talent Award', runners up in 'Best AI-ML Adoption', 'Best Tech bank', and 'Best Digital Sales'. Furthermore, they won a special mention for 'Best FinTech and Digital Payment Index Adoption' and 'Best IT and Risk Management' {{Cite web |date=2026-01-14 |title=South Indian Bank Wins Big at IBA Awards |url=https://www.passionateinmarketing.com/south-indian-bank-sweeps-iba-banking-awards-2024-25/ |access-date=2026-07-31 |website=Passionate In Marketing |language=en-US}}. * SIB emerged as the best performer in Asset Quality category in Analyst 2008 Survey of Indian Banks among private sector banks, including both traditional and new banks {{Cite web |title=South Ind.Bank Summary: Latest Updates and Details |url=https://www.indiainfoline.com/company/south-indian-bank-ltd/summary |access-date=2026-07-31 |website=India Infoline |language=en}}. ==See also== {{Portal|Banks}} * [[Banking in India]] * [[List of banks in India]] * [[Reserve Bank of India]] * [[Indian Financial System Code]] * [[List of largest banks]] * [[List of companies of India]] * [[Make in India]] ==References== {{Reflist|30em}} ==External links== {{Commons category}} * [http://www.southindianbank.bank.in/ Official web site] * [http://www.indiainfoline.com/Research/LeaderSpeak/Dr.-V.A-Joseph-Managing-Director-and-CEO-South-Indian-Bank/22607739 Interview of Dr. V.A Joseph, Former Managing Director & CEO, South Indian Bank] {{Thrissur topics}} {{Banking in India}} {{Authority control}} [[Category:South Indian Bank| ]] [[Category:Banks based in Thrissur]] [[Category:Banks established in 1929]] [[Category:Private sector banks in India]] [[Category:Indian companies established in 1928]] [[Category:Indian companies established in 1929]] [[Category:Companies listed on the National Stock Exchange of India]] [[Category:Companies listed on the Bombay Stock Exchange]]

The South Indian Bank Limited (SIB) is a major private-sector bank headquartered at Thrissur in Kerala, India in 1992.  The same came into being during the Swadeshi movement . It began as a private limited company and was later converted into a public limited company in 1939. The bank provides retail and corporate banking services, para banking activities, third party distribution along with Treasury and Foreign Exchange Business .  
As of 31 December 2024, the bank had a network of 955 banking outlets (954 branches and 1 service branch) and 1290 ATMs/CRMs (1159 ATMs and 131 CRMs) spanning 26 states and 4 union territories).
